title: == compares the contents of objects
statement: Comparing two object variables with == compares what is inside the objects, so two objects with the same field values are equal.

evidence_patterns.item_shape: predict == on two distinct objects with equal contents

discriminators.vs_slip: Consistent across items and the learner sees no difference between == and equals. A slip is choosing the wrong operator once while knowing the difference.

vs.prog.obj.variables-hold-objects: Learners with no reference concept also predict true, but for a different reason (they see no identity to compare). Ask what == compares.

conflicts_with.label: == on references compares identity, not contents

resolved_by.label: == on references compares identity, not contents
An object variable holds a reference; assignment copies the reference
